name: anim_jyu_slam_sway2
subject: a huge, heavy bear man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream splotches and a big round belly
desc: Loop: facing straight toward the viewer with both hands on his hips, he slowly and sensually grinds his hips, twisting them to the left and then to the right in a slow, sticky, teasing rhythm, the chest and the big belly swaying and rolling with it, the feet planted. The face keeps the same eyebrows, nose, closed mouth and half-lidded eyes looking down at the viewer with a heavy smug gaze. Thick, sticky, viscous paint, slow and heavy.
